ONGC donations to Sangh-linked groups under scrutiny

Reports indicate that the state-owned Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) donated over Rs 668 crore to 20 organizations linked to the Sangh over a period of 10 to 12 years. These donations were reportedly made from corporate social responsibility (CSR) funds. The details of these transactions have come to light through recent reporting.
